description:
**Role Description**
**Why Join 7\-Eleven Global Solution Center?**
 When you join us, you'll embrace ownership as teams within specific product areas take responsibility for end\-to\-end solution delivery, supporting local teams and integrating new digital assets. Challenge yourself by contributing to products deployed across our extensive network of convenience stores, processing over a billion transactions annually. Build solutions for scale, addressing the diverse needs of our 84,000\+ stores in 19 countries. Experience growth through cross\-functional learning, encouraged and applauded at 7\-Eleven GSC. With our size, stability, and resources, you can navigate a rewarding career. Embody leadership and service as 7\-Eleven GSC remains dedicated to meeting the needs of customers and communities.
   

  

**Why We Exist, Our Purpose and Our Transformation?**
 7\-Eleven is dedicated to being a customer\-centric, digitally empowered organization that seamlessly integrates our physical stores with digital offerings. Our goal is to redefine convenience by consistently providing top\-notch customer experiences and solutions in a rapidly evolving consumer landscape. Anticipating customer preferences, we create and implement platforms that empower customers to shop, pay, and access products and services according to their preferences. To achieve success, we are driving a cultural shift anchored in leadership principles, supported by the realignment of organizational resources and processes.
   

  

 At 7\-Eleven we are guided by our
 **Leadership Principles** 
 . Each principle has a defined set of behaviours which help guide the 7\-Eleven GSC team to Serve Customers and Support Stores.
   

  

* Be Customer Obsessed
* Be Courageous with Your Point of View
* Challenge the Status Quo
* Act Like an Entrepreneur
* Have an “It Can Be Done” Attitude
* Do the Right Thing
* Be Accountable


**About This Opportunity**
**Job Title:** 
**Human Resource Business Partner**
**Location: Bangalore**
**Job Description**
 As a HR Business Partner, you will be an embedded people partner across your assigned business units — engaging with leaders at all levels, from front\-line managers to senior stakeholders, to drive people outcomes that enable business performance. This role demands equal measures of strategic thinking, analytical rigour, and executional excellence. You will contribute meaningfully across key HR domains — including org design, workforce planning, career frameworks, change management, and data\-driven people insights — working in close collaboration with COE teams and your Talent Management manager to deliver integrated solutions.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 ▸ Partner with leaders across levels — from front\-line managers to senior stakeholders — to translate business priorities into actionable people plans.
   

  

 ▸ Support org design engagements by assessing structures, modelling options, and helping implement changes that improve clarity and effectiveness.
   

  

 ▸ Contribute to the design and upkeep of career frameworks — including job families, levelling criteria, and progression pathways for assigned functions.
   

  

 ▸ Facilitate performance management cycles, guiding managers on goal\-setting, mid\-year reviews, and year\-end calibrations, ensuring consistent application across the business unit.
   

  

 ▸ Coach managers on having effective performance conversations, addressing underperformance, and building development plans for their teams.
   

  

 ▸ Support succession planning and high\-potential identification in partnership with the Talent Management team.
   

  

 ▸ Lead the people workstream in change programmes — develop impact assessments, communication plans, and adoption strategies for restructures or transformation initiatives.
   

  

 ▸ Build and maintain HR dashboards tracking key metrics such as attrition, headcount, engagement, and performance trends.
   

  

 ▸ Use Excel and other data tools to build workforce models, analyse trends, and support business case development.
   

  

 ▸ Build trusted relationships with leaders, Finance, and COE partners (Talent Acquisition, L\&D, Rewards, People Ops) to deliver joined\-up people solutions.
   

  

 ▸ Represent the people agenda in leadership forums, planning sessions, and quarterly business reviews.
   

  

**Key Skills Required**
 ▸ Strategic thinker with the ability to zoom out to see the big picture and zoom in to execute flawlessly.
   

  

 ▸ Proficient in Microsoft Excel — comfortable with advanced formulas, pivot tables, dashboards
   

  

 ▸ Strong analytical mindset; ability to structure complex problems and communicate insights simply.
   

  

 ▸ Exceptional communication and influencing skills — credible across leadership levels and adaptable across audiences.
   

  

 ▸ High degree of comfort with ambiguity and the ability to prioritise ruthlessly in a fast\-moving environment.
   

  

 ▸ Demonstrated integrity and discretion in handling sensitive people matters.
   

  

**Preferred Qualifications**
 ▸ 5–9 years of progressive HR experience with at least 3–4 years in a senior HRBP or strategic HR role.
   

  

 ▸ Demonstrated experience delivering org design, career framework, or large\-scale change management projects.
   

  

 ▸ Exposure to fast\-paced, high\-growth environments — tech, consulting, or MNC preferred.
   

  

**Privileges \& Perquisites**
**7\-Eleven Global Solution Center** 
 offers a comprehensive benefits plan tailored to meet the needs and improve the overall experience of our employees, aiding in the management of both their professional and personal aspects.
   

  

**Work\-Life Balance:** 
 Encouraging employees to unwind, recharge, and find balance, we offer flexible and hybrid work schedules along with diverse leave options. Supplementary allowances and compensatory days off are provided for specific work demands.
   

  

**Well\-Being \& Family Protection:** 
 Comprehensive medical coverage for spouses, children, and parents/in\-laws, with voluntary top\-up plans, OPD coverage, day care services, and access to health coaches. Additionally, an Employee Assistance Program with free, unbiased and confidential expert consultations for personal and professional issues.
   

  

 Top of Form
   

  

**Wheels and Meals:** 
 Free transportation and cafeteria facilities with diverse menu options including breakfast, lunch, snacks, and beverages, customizable and health\-conscious choices.
   

  

**Certification \& Training Program:** 
 Sponsored training for specialized certifications. Investment in employee development through labs and learning platforms.
   

  

**Hassel free Relocation:** 
 Support and reimbursement for newly hired employees relocating to Bangalore, India.
   

  

*7\-Eleven Global Solution Center is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to diversity in the workplace. Our strategy focuses on three core pillars – workplace culture, diverse talent and how we show up in the communities we serve. As the recognized leader in convenience, the 7\-Eleven family of brands embraces diversity, equity and inclusion (DE\+I). It’s not only the right thing to do for customers, Franchisees and employees—it’s a business imperative.*

description:
**Description**
 At Amazon India, to achieve our mission to be the most customer\-centric company on earth, and provide our customers with the best experience possible, our goal is to deliver each package, no matter how large or small, to our customers when and where they need them, as quickly, accurately and cost\-effectively as possible, and through a choice of innovative delivery options. INOPS ER team is part of the Global Employee Relations vertical within Amazon, and works closely with the Field People eXperience and Technology (PXT / HR) teams and Operations teams in advising and enabling them to provide a seamless employee and associate experience. Our network of drivers and delivery service providers is growing rapidly, and to support this growth we are looking forward to ER Specialists to join the Employee Relations team.
   

  

 We are looking for candidates with who possess communication and interpersonal skills that let them communicate with ease, across levels from shop floor employees to senior leaders. The role will set in motion and numerous programs that develop and nurture a positive work environment, and advancing our work towards being the earth’s best employer.
   

  

 The central objective of this role is to ensure we sustain positive ER climate at our buildings and ensure fair, respectful, and consistent experience for people. The individual will be responsible to drive agenda of creating a positive driver relations climate that supports safety, capability, engagement and a high performance, customer\-obsessed culture. The candidate will possess the ability to complete high volumes of tasks with minimal guidance or supervision and deadline sensitivity. You'll operate independently, manage multiple priorities, and contribute to building scalable mechanisms that strengthen the driver experience across Amazon India's last\-mile network.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Problem Solve: Work independently with minimal supervision, in ambiguous situations, and persevere over internal and external barriers to drive resolutions. Analyze, diagnose, design, and revise people programs, policies, and practices to sustain positive employee relations
* Leverage a deep understanding for the breadth of experience / morale drivers to prioritize programs and investments that will measurably improve ER climate within last mile cohorts.
* Work across program, product and tech teams to design and drive impacting initiatives and implement mechanisms to continuously improve the LM experience.
* Analyze and Interpret Data: Exercise analytical skills using data and anecdotes to develop persuasive narratives and recommendations; demonstrated ability to define and measure success of programs. Design, collect, and analyze multiple levels of employee feedback
* Connect with associates on ground to understand their experience in terms of what’s working well and what needs improvement. Identify the issues / concerns that need to be resolved.
* Partner with business to find out the best solutions and actions to close loop.
* Lead business reviews to drive focus
* Should be able to travel to sites inter/intracity for driving proactive listening mechanisms.
* Lead the ER capability building agenda for respective business/PXT teams to enable positive ER climate at the sites.
* Collaborate with OTR (On The Road) stakeholders to drive engagement initiatives that improve experience


**Basic Qualifications**
* Master's degree in business, HR, or a related field
* 2\+ years of HR experience


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience in conducting investigative work, including claimant, witness, and target employee interviews, investigative data analysis, and production of investigative documentation
* Experience managing confidential and sensitive employee information and adherence to strict confidentiality standards
* Experience building cross\-functional partnerships and influencing stakeholders across the organization to act without having a direct reporting relationship

title: Employee Relations Manager
description:
**Description**
**Who is USP?**
 The U.S. Pharmacopeial Convention (USP) is an independent scientific organization that collaborates with the world’s leading health and science experts to develop rigorous quality standards for medicines, dietary supplements, and food ingredients. At USP, we believe that scientific excellence is driven by a commitment to fairness, integrity, and global collaboration. This belief is embedded in our core value of Passion for Quality and is demonstrated through the contributions of more than 1,300 professionals across twenty global locations, working to strengthen the supply of safe, high\-quality medicines worldwide.
   

  

 At USP, we value inclusive scientific collaboration and recognize that attracting diverse expertise strengthens our ability to develop trusted public health standards. We foster an organizational culture that supports equitable access to mentorship, professional development, and leadership opportunities. Our partnerships, standards, and research reflect our belief that ensuring broad participation in scientific leadership results in stronger, more impactful outcomes for global health.
   

  

 USP is proud to be an equal employment opportunity employer (EEOE) and is committed to ensuring fair, merit\-based selection processes that enable the best scientific minds—regardless of background—to contribute to advancing public health solutions worldwide. We provide reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities and uphold policies that create an inclusive and collaborative work environment.
   

  

**Brief Job Overview**
 The Employee Relations Manager is responsible for fostering a positive work environment by managing employee relations programs, resolving workplace issues, and ensuring compliance with labor laws and company policies. This role serves as a trusted advisor to management and employees, promoting fairness, consistency, and engagement across the organization strengthening the compliance culture.
   

  

**How will YOU create impact here at USP?**
 As part of our mission to advance scientific rigor and public health standards, you will play a vital role in increasing global access to high\-quality medicines through public standards and related programs. USP prioritizes scientific integrity, regulatory excellence, and evidence\-based decision\-making to ensure health systems worldwide can rely on strong, tested, and globally relevant quality standards.
   

  

 Additionally, USP’s People and Culture division, in partnership with the Equity Office, invests in leadership and workforce development to equip all employees with the skills to create high\-performing, inclusive teams. This includes training in equitable management practices and tools to promote engaged, collaborative, and results\-driven work environments.
   

  

**The Employee Relations Manager Has The Following Responsibilities**
* Investigate and lead the people\-related issues such as: behavior/conduct concerns, corrective actions for policy violations, employee grievances, and workplace conflicts in a timely and confidential manner.
* Liaise with labor offices and regulatory authorities to ensure compliance with statutory requirements and manage audits or inspections.
* Ensure adherence to labor laws, regulations, and internal HR policies.
* Provide guidance, in alignment with the HRBPs, to managers on addressing/resolving investigation outcomes, findings and recommendations, and related corrective and developmental actions.
* Review and update employee relations policies and procedures as needed.
* Partner with HRBPs to address complex employee relations cases, provide strategic solutions, embed compliance and ethical practices into organizational culture.
* Collaborate with global and regional Compliance, Ethics, and Legal teams to ensure alignment with corporate standards and regulatory frameworks.
* Analyze ER data, highlight key trends and provide insights that lead to the formulation of recommendations that drive positive employee relations programs and process improvements.
* Anchor / support the compliance awareness sessions \& training on policies, risk management practices, and other emerging or specific issues to promote consistent understanding across teams.


**Who is USP Looking For?**
 The Successful Candidate Will Have a Demonstrated Understanding Of Our Mission, Commitment To Excellence Through Inclusive And Equitable Behaviors And Practices, Ability To Quickly Build Credibility With Stakeholders, Along With The Following Competencies And Experience
   

  

* Masters Degree/Post Graduate Diploma/Masters in Social Work (Full\-Time) in Human Resource Management.
* 8\+ years of experience in employee relations.
* Strong knowledge in Indian Labour laws and compliance requirements
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills .
* Strategic thinking and problem\-solving abilities .
* Demonstrated capability to drive outcomes through collaboration and persuasion.


**Additional Desired Preferences**
* Degree in Law is preferred.
* Ability to work in a highly matrix environment.


**Supervisory Responsibilities**
 Nil
   

  

**Benefits**
 USP provides the benefits to protect yourself and your family today and tomorrow. From company\-paid time off and comprehensive healthcare options to retirement savings, you can have peace of mind that your personal and financial well\-being is protected.
   

  

 Note: USP does not accept unsolicited resumes from 3rd party recruitment agencies and is not responsible for fees from recruiters or other agencies except under specific written agreement with USP.
   

  

**Job Category** 
 Human Resources
   

  

**Job Type** 
 Full\-Time

description:

Job Summary

An Equity Dealer is responsible for executing buy and sell orders in the stock market on behalf of clients or the company. The role involves monitoring market trends, providing trading support, maintaining client relationships, and ensuring compliance with financial regulations.

* Execute equity, derivatives, and other market trades accurately and efficiently.

* Communication and client\-handling ability.

* Bachelor’s degree in Commerce, Finance, Business, or related field.

Experience

* Fresher or 1–3 years of experience in stock broking/trading.

title: Manual QA Tester
description:
Company: 42Peaks (Celestivox Technologies Pvt. Ltd.)
   

  

 Location: Lucknow — on\-site / hybrid
   

  

 Type: Full\-time
   

  

 Reports to: Director
   

  

 Compensation:10K \- 12K per month
   

  

**About The Role**
 We build software for educators, and we care a lot about getting things right before they reach a customer. You'll be the person who finds the problems first.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on manual testing role. You'll work through new features and builds methodically, find what's broken or confusing, write it up clearly, and verify the fix. You'll maintain test cases, keep a known\-good reference set to test against, and make sure nothing that worked yesterday quietly stops working today.
   

  

 There's a real product, real customers, and a small team — so what you catch matters, and you'll see the impact of your work quickly.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Test new features and builds across desktop and web, methodically and thoroughly.
* Find bugs, reproduce them reliably, and write them up so they can actually be fixed — clear steps, expected vs. actual, the conditions that trigger it.
* Maintain test cases and a reference set of known\-correct examples to check results against.
* Run regression passes so old bugs stay fixed.
* Verify fixes and close the loop.
* Keep the issue tracker clean and honest about what's working and what isn't.


**You should have**
* Genuine attention to detail and the patience to test the boring paths, not just the happy one.
* The instinct to try the thing a user would actually do — including the wrong thing.
* Clear written communication. A good bug report is half the fix.
* Comfort with structured testing: working from test cases, tracking what's been covered, being systematic rather than random.
* Basic comfort with tools — issue trackers, test\-case management, getting builds installed and running.


**A major plus**
* Any experience with test automation, however small. Scripts, tools, frameworks — if you've started down that road, we want to hear about it. This role can grow toward automation over time for the right person.


**What does work look like here?**
 Small team, no bureaucracy, a direct line to the people writing the code. You'll have real ownership of quality and a clear view of why your work matters. We value people who are straight about what's broken, who'd rather flag a problem early than let it ship, and who take pride in catching the thing everyone else missed. Year one is about earning trust — and good testing is a big part of how we earn it.

description:
**Title: Associate Information Security and Compliance**

Location: Mumbai


Education: Any Degree (Computer Science)


Exp: 0\-2 Years  



The Information Security and Compliance Associate will support the execution of Information Security, Privacy, and AI Management System (AIMS) programs aligned with ISO 27001, ISO 27701, and ISO 42001 standards. The role involves assisting in compliance monitoring, audit activities, and risk assessments using ServiceNow GRC and defined control frameworks. The associate will also support periodic reporting and ensure adherence to organizational policies and procedures.  



**Core Responsibilities:**

**Compliance \& Monitoring**

Conduct periodic compliance checks and update findings in line with defined policies and procedures.


Record, track, and maintain audit/compliance tickets in ServiceNow GRC.


Perform regular health checks of security tools and review daily alerts/events.


Support ongoing monitoring of security controls across IT, HR, FM, and business operations.


Participate in periodic control assessments mapped to ISO 27001, ISO 27701, and AIMS requirements.  



**Audit \& Risk Support**

* Assist in internal audits covering information security, privacy, and AI controls.
* Document audit observations, evidence, and status updates in ServiceNow GRC.
* Support enterprise risk assessment activities as per the defined risk management calendar.
* Assist in third\-party/vendor risk assessments using established frameworks and tools.

**Security Operations Support**

* Perform periodic reviews of key security domains such as Vulnerability Management, DLP, Endpoint Security, and SIEM.
* Proactively monitor and update security incidents, service requests, and compliance tickets.
* Assist in the preparation of dashboards and compliance/security metrics reporting.

**Reporting \& Continuous Improvement**

* Generate periodic reports and metrics for management on compliance and security posture.
* Identify opportunities to enhance reporting quality, control effectiveness, and process efficiency.

**Skills and Experience:**

* Fresher or entry\-level experience in Information Security, Audit, or Compliance.
* Basic understanding of IT systems, cybersecurity tools, and control environments.
* Familiarity with standards such as ISO 27001/27002, ISO 27701, ISO 42001 (AIMS), NIST, or PCI\-DSS is preferred.

**Key Attributes:**

* Strong interpersonal skills and ability to collaborate across teams.
* Effective verbal and written communication skills.
* High integrity and adherence to ethical standards.
* Ability to grasp technical and compliance concepts quickly.
* Strong learning mindset and attention to detail.
* Process\-oriented with a focus on consistency and improvement.

**Qualifications:**

* Graduate in Computer Science or equivalent field.
* Certifications or basic knowledge in security and audit standards (e.g., ISO 27001 LI/LA, ISO 27701, CISA – preferred but not mandatory).

CACTUS is a remote\-first organization and we embrace an accelerate from anywhere culture. You may be required to travel to our Mumbai office based on business requirements or for company/team events.  

As an Associate Process Manager, you will be a part of the Workflow Management (WFM) team, which is responsible for coordinating the flow of work coming to the editing department, working with your client servicing team to meet customer requirements and being the first point of contact for freelance editors working across the globe.
Job responsibilities:
* Collaborate with the editing, client servicing, and customer care teams to understand and deliver against client requirements
* Coordinate with and answer queries from in\-house and freelance editors across the globe in a timely and professional manner
* Having an in\-depth knowledge of all processes within the company
* Cultivating solid relationships with editor through providing a great personal yet professional environment
* Interacting with editors through phone calls and email communications


Qualifications and prerequisites:
* Minimum one\-year experience as a client servicing executive would be preferred; although freshers are also welcome
* Fluent English communication and good email\-writing skills with attention to grammar, empathy and internal processes
* Excellent organizational and time management skills with the ability to multitask
* Analytical skills to identify and plug inefficiencies
* Maintaining a positive frame while dealing with high pressure situations
* Proficiency in MS Word and Excel would be beneficial

 **Working Shifts:** The candidate is expected to work in rotational shifts with two weekly offs.
Application process:

Before applying, please ensure you meet the role requirements listed above and have legal authorization to work in the country where this role is advertised. Our selection process typically involves an initial screening by a recruiter, a technical assessment, and two to three interview rounds. For this role, you will first have an assessment round followed by two interview rounds.

 **Equal Opportunity**

  

Our hiring practices reflect our commitment to providing equal opportunities and creating an environment where everyone can thrive, develop, and succeed. We celebrate the uniqueness of our team members and prohibit discrimination of any kind, based on race, color, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, or any other protected characteristic.

 **Accelerating from Anywhere**


As a remote\-first organization, these are essential attributes we look for in all our candidates.

* Taking ownership of your work with minimal supervision, showing strong ability to organize, prioritize and deliver results independently.
* Documenting work that brings everyone on the same page.
* Maturity to choose between synchronous and asynchronous collaboration.
* Effectively collaborating with colleagues across different time zones by setting dedicated hours for collaboration and keeping team members updated through your MS Teams status.


About Us:

Established in 2002, Cactus Communications (cactusglobal.com) is a leading technology company that specializes in expert services and AI\-driven products which improve how research gets funded, published, communicated, and discovered. Its flagship brand Editage offers a comprehensive suite of researcher solutions, including expert services and cutting\-edge AI products like Mind the Graph, Paperpal, and R Discovery. With offices in Princeton, London, Singapore, Beijing, Shanghai, Seoul, Tokyo, and Mumbai and a global workforce of over 3,000 experts, CACTUS is a pioneer in workplace best practices and has been consistently recognized as a great place to work.

title: Audit Associate – Statutory Audit
description:
Position : Audit Associate – Statutory Audit  

Department : Statutory Audit  

Employment type: Full\-time  

Positions: 1  

Qualification: Qualified CA (freshers welcome)  

Location : Hyderabad  

Experience : 1 year of post\-qualification experience; freshers welcome  

Reporting To: Audit Manager / Engagement Partner


About Us


KVA is a boutique\-chartered accounting and advisory firm based in Hyderabad, with a legacy of over 40 years. Over the years, we have grown to become one of the leading firms in the city, serving a diverse set of clients across industries.


We operate within a strong global and sector\-focused ecosystem. Through our association with DFK International, we are connected to member firms across \~90 countries, enabling us to support clients on complex cross\-border matters. We are also closely aligned with Sathguru Management Consultants, bringing deep expertise in the life sciences sector and enhancing the value we deliver to clients in this space.


As a group of \~200 professionals, we work with businesses across India and internationally. While we continue to provide core audit and tax services, a significant part of our practice today focuses on high\-value advisory, including international taxation, structuring, and M\&A.


Role Description


We are looking for a qualified Chartered Accountant to join our Statutory Audit team in Hyderabad. The role involves working on end\-to\-end audit engagements for companies across industries, supporting the team in delivering high\-quality, compliant audits. It is a strong launchpad for a recently qualified CA, with direct exposure to clients, financial statements, and the full audit lifecycle.


Key Roles and Responsibilities  



* Execute substantive and analytical audit procedures under the guidance of seniors and managers.
* Vouch and verify transactions, test internal controls, and document working papers as per firm and SA (Standards on Auditing) requirements.
* Assist in preparation and review of financial statements as per applicable framework (Ind AS / AS) and Schedule III of the Companies Act, 2013
* Perform ledger scrutiny, ratio analysis, and identify unusual or high\-risk transactions.
* Support compliance checks across Income Tax, GST, TDS, and Companies Act requirements relevant to the audit.
* Maintain audit documentation and ensure timely closure of assigned sections.
* Coordinate with client finance teams to obtain data, reconciliations, and supporting evidence.
* Flag observations and potential audit issues to seniors promptly.


Qualification \& Eligibility  



* Qualified Chartered Accountant (CA) (recently cleared, both groups)
* Experience: 1 year of post\-qualification experience; freshers welcome
* Completed articleship in audit/assurance preferred.


Skills  



* Sound knowledge of statutory audit procedures and applicable financial reporting frameworks (Ind AS / AS)
* Strong grasp of Standards on Auditing and the Companies Act, 2013
* Proficiency in MS Excel and working knowledge of accounting/audit software (Tally, audit tools, etc.)
* Attention to detail, analytical thinking, and a methodical approach to documentation.
* Good written and verbal communication; ability to interact professionally with clients.
* Willingness to travel for fieldwork and to meet engagement deadlines.


What We Offer  



* Structured exposure to diverse audit engagements and industries
* Mentorship from experienced managers and partners
* A collaborative team environment with clear growth pathways

**About the role**  
Join our NPI Engineering team to design and develop precision assemblies that meet demanding customer requirements—balancing thermal and mechanical performance, manufacturability, and schedule. You’ll move from concept to prototype to production, collaborating cross‑functionally to deliver high‑quality products on time and within budget. This position requires a high level of attention to detail, organizational, project management and multi\-tasking skills, including proactive problem solving. As part of the NPI Engineering, team will be expected to offer suggestions and participate in Continuous Improvement initiatives.

**What you’ll do**

* Translate customer requirements (BOMs, 2D/3D drawings, specifications) into manufacturable designs and documentation.
* Estimate time \& materials Costing, Part fabrication machining time and assembly time estimation
* Prepare manufacturing drawings including pre\-brazing or pre\-welding part drawings
* Prepare OMS (operational method sheet) which includes manufacturing process flow diagram, BOM, and work instructions
* Prepare finished part drawings including redlines and ECR/ECO
* Fabricate prototype working with purchasing and manufacturing
* Prototype testing including thermal cycling/uniformity
* Prepare FAI (first article inspection) report
* Perform detailed documentation to track project development and design process
* Ensure project timeline is met and project stays within budget
* Manage mechanical design, stress analysis, and machine parts manufacturing processes with outside suppliers to satisfy delivery requirements.
* Generate and present technical information in report and oral presentation format.
* Support design reviews and proposal content.

**What you’ll bring**

* Proficiency with 3D CAD (Inventor, Solid Edge, SolidWorks) and ability to read assemblies/blueprints/schematics.
* Experience with thermal applications, sensing/heater systems; familiarity with COMSOL a plus.
* Strong communication, technical writing/presentations, and project/time management skills.
* Electrical drafting capabilities, ACADE (Autodesk) or some equivalent
* Must have strong communication and project management skills along with engineering aptitude.
* Skilled at performing appropriate engineering analyses.
* Effective at communication including technical writing and oral presentations.
* Capable of managing projects, including costs and schedules.
* Effective at time management.
* (Level III \& Sr) SPC methods, FEA (thermal/stress), Lean/Six Sigma, and 8D problem‑solving exposure.
* Education/Experience by level: Level I—BS in Mechanical (Manufacturing/Electro‑Mechanical or equivalent); Level II—4\+ yrs; Level III—6\+ yrs; Sr—10\+ yrs.

**Why you’ll love it here**  
Therm\-x of California stands out as a premier destination for professionals passionate about precision engineering, advanced manufacturing, and impactful innovation. With its headquarters in Hayward, CA, Therm\-x has built a reputation since 1983 as a leader in thermal solutions—serving high\-tech industries through vertically integrated capabilities that span thermal design and testing, CNC machining, metal joining, sheet metal fabrication, and electro\-mechanical assembly. Your work will be Impactful, hands‑on engineering across the full lifecycle; opportunities to lead and mentor; collaborative culture focused on quality and delivery.

**Description:**About IHCL

Indian Hotels Company Limited (IHCL) is a part of the Tata Group and is one of South Asia's largest and most iconic hospitality companies. With a legacy of over 120 years, we are dedicated to delivering exceptional experiences to our guests through our diverse portfolio of hotels, resorts, and palaces.
Careers at IHCL

At IHCL, we believe our employees are our greatest asset. We are committed to fostering a dynamic work environment that encourages innovation, collaboration, and personal growth. Join us in creating memorable experiences and shaping the future of hospitality. Explore exciting career opportunities with us and be a part of a vibrant team that values passion, excellence, and diversity.
Job Objective

This position exists for leading the Security \& Safety team at a property, ensuring full compliance with safety regulations, fire and life safety standards, and implementing security protocols effectively. The role involves managing incidents, conducting risk assessments, overseeing staff training, and ensuring a safe and secure environment for both guests and employees.

Essential Job Tasks

Assists in leading the security and safety function for a large property or manages a mid\-size property independently. Supervises staff, ensures compliance with security protocols, and leads emergency preparedness programs. Conducts risk assessments and leads incident investigations. Collaborates with property leadership on safety and security strategies, managing projects such as security system upgrades and safety audits.

Areas of Responsibility

1\. Leadership and Supervision of Security \& Safety Operations.  

* Operational Leadership. Lead day\-to\-day operations of the security and safety team, ensuring effective coordination among security supervisors, executives, and guards. Oversee the deployment and readiness of staff during routine operations and emergencies.
* Staff Scheduling and Performance Management. Manage staff rosters, ensuring adequate coverage for all shifts, including night patrols. Conduct regular performance reviews, provide feedback, and recommend training and development opportunities for team members.
* Leadership in Incident Response. Act as the point of escalation during security and safety incidents, ensuring swift and accurate responses by the team. Oversee the team's handling of incidents, from initial response to follow\-up investigation and reporting.

2\. Property Patrols, Safety Inspections, and Incident Management.  

* Regular Patrol Supervision. Direct and oversee routine property patrols, focusing on critical areas such as entry/exit points, guest room corridors, parking areas, and high\-risk zones. Ensure that patrol staff promptly report and address potential risks such as unauthorized access or safety hazards.
* Inspection and Compliance. Conduct daily and weekly safety inspections of the property, ensuring compliance with fire safety standards, life safety protocols, and equipment readiness. Check firefighting systems, alarms, exit routes, and emergency signage for operational readiness.
* Incident Management. Ensure prompt response to any security or safety incidents, such as fire alarms, medical emergencies, or unauthorized access. Conduct post\-incident investigations, ensuring all relevant documentation is completed and corrective actions are taken.

3\. Access Control \& Surveillance Management.  

* Access Point Management. Oversee all access control points, ensuring the team diligently monitors and restricts unauthorized access to sensitive areas such as server rooms, storage, and restricted guest zones. Implement and enforce security protocols for visitors, contractors, and vendors.
* Surveillance Systems Oversight. Manage the surveillance systems, including CCTV, ensuring all cameras are operational and positioned strategically to cover key areas. Supervise the live monitoring process, ensuring that operators proactively report suspicious activity or security breaches in real\-time.
* Card Access Systems. Supervise the proper management of electronic access systems, ensuring accurate logging and review of access logs for sensitive or restricted areas.

4\. Fire \& Life Safety Management.  

* Fire Safety Protocols. Oversee the maintenance and readiness of fire detection systems, firefighting equipment, and evacuation routes. Ensure all fire drills are conducted in compliance with regulatory standards and property guidelines. Review fire safety protocols regularly to ensure optimal preparedness.
* Life Safety Preparedness. Manage life safety programs, including first aid, medical response, and emergency evacuation plans. Ensure all staff and relevant stakeholders are trained in emergency evacuation procedures and are aware of safety assembly points.
* Fire Drills and Emergency Simulations. Conduct regular fire drills, medical emergency simulations, and crisis scenario rehearsals with property staff to ensure preparedness for various emergencies.

5\. Risk Assessments, Audits, and Compliance.  

* Comprehensive Risk Management. Conduct comprehensive security and safety risk assessments on the property, identifying vulnerabilities in physical security, access control, and fire/life safety systems. Ensure appropriate mitigation strategies are put in place to address identified risks.
  


Required Qualifications
* Bachelor’s degree in Security Management, Occupational Health \& Safety, or equivalent

description:

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

**Title and Summary**


Sr. Specialist, Product Analysis – Core HR/P\&C Products\-1
Overview
  

  

The Sr. Specialist, Product Analysis converts defined product direction and business needs into detailed requirements, workflows, and system configurations across P\&C (HR) product domains.
  

  

Working closely with Product Managers, Experience Owners, HR stakeholders, Engineering, and enterprise systems teams, this role ensures product initiatives are clearly defined, validated, and successfully executed across a multi\-system HR environment, including Workday and other integrated platforms.
  

  

This role is responsible for end\-to\-end execution across the product delivery lifecycle, supporting requirements, configuration, testing, demos, UAT, and release activities to deliver high\-quality, scalable HR product capabilities.  

  

  

  

Opportunity \& Role Mission
  

  

This role offers the opportunity to support a modern HR Products organization delivering integrated HR experiences across Workday and a broader ecosystem of HR systems and platforms.
  

  

You will transform established product direction into build\-ready requirements and scalable system configurations, ensuring consistency and quality across systems and teams.
  

  

Your work will enable efficient delivery by ensuring requirements are complete, systems are properly configured, integrations are supported in partnership with engineering, dependencies are aligned, and releases are thoroughly validated.
  

  

What You’ll Do
  

  

Document business requirements, user stories, workflows, and system/configuration needs in partnership with Product Managers and stakeholders based on prioritized requests
  

  

Support system configuration and low\-/no\-code changes (including Workday and other HR platforms) within established product standards and governance
  

  

Partner with Engineering to support integration\-related requirements, validation, and issue resolution across interconnected HR systems
  

  

Execute test scripts, validate system changes, and support QA, demo readiness, and release deployment activities
  

  

Lead and coordinate User Acceptance Testing (UAT), including test planning, execution support, defect tracking, and stakeholder sign\-off
  

  

Provide day\-to\-day product and system support, troubleshoot issues, and coordinate resolution with Product, Engineering, and system owners
  

  

Maintain process documentation, configuration details, release notes, and testing records
  

  

Prepare and support product demos and stakeholder walkthroughs to validate functionality and readiness
  

  

Identify opportunities for incremental product, process, system, and user experience improvements
  

  

Partner across HR, Talent Acquisition, Total Rewards, Engineering, and technology teams to support effective delivery, integration alignment, and adoption  

  

  

  

What You Bring
  

  

Experience in product analysis, business analysis, or HR technology roles with a strong focus on execution and delivery
  

  

Hands\-on experience with Workday\- including configuration (e.g., business processes, reporting, security, calculated fields), plus familiarity with other HR systems and platforms
  

  

Experience working in multi\-system environments, including supporting or coordinating with Engineering on integrations
  

  

Proven experience supporting QA, demos, UAT, and release processes
  

  

Strong analytical, documentation, and requirements management skills
  

  

Ability to translate business needs into clear, actionable requirements and system configurations
  

  

Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality and accuracy
  

  

Ability to operate independently and manage work across multiple priorities
  

  

Strong collaboration and communication skills across cross\-functional stakeholders
  

  

Experience with Agile tools and methodologies (e.g., Jira, Confluence, AHA)
  

  

Experience with HR domains such as
  

  

Core HCM, Payroll, Benefits, Absence, \& Time Tracking, Reporting (strongly preferred)
  

  

Experience with end\-user training or enablement (preferred)  

  

  

  

What Success Looks Like
  

  

Requirements are clear, complete, and ready for build without ambiguity or rework
  

  

Systems (including Workday and integrated platforms) are configured accurately and consistently
  

  

QA, demos, and UAT cycles are well\-executed and lead to high\-quality releases

description:
**Experience**
 10–12 years of experience in HR Operations, with at least 5–7 years in a managerial role.
   

  

**About Stellium**
 At Stellium (now Körber Stellium), we specialize in delivering SAP\-driven supply chain and digital transformation solutions. Our culture is built on innovation, ownership, and collaboration, creating an environment where people and ideas scale together to deliver meaningful enterprise impact.
   

  

 Job Title
   

  

 Senior HR Generalist
   

  

 Location
   

  

 Mangalore (Onsite)
   

  

**Job Description**
 Stellium is seeking an experienced Senior Manager – HR Operations to lead and strengthen our HR operational framework as the organization continues to expand globally. This role is critical in ensuring seamless execution of people processes, maintaining compliance, enhancing employee experience, and supporting HR digital transformation initiatives.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* HR Operations \& Service Delivery: Lead and oversee end\-to\-end HR operations for India while supporting global requirements, ensuring seamless execution of all employee lifecycle processes, including onboarding, confirmations, transfers, promotions, and offboarding, maintaining data accuracy in HR systems, and driving standardization of HR processes across locations.
* HRIS \& Digital Enablement (SuccessFactors): Own governance of SuccessFactors by ensuring data accuracy and process compliance, coordinating system enhancements and integrations with the technology team, driving automation of manual HR workflows, and developing dashboards and analytics to support leadership decision\-making.
* Compliance \& Policy Governance: Ensure adherence to statutory and labour law requirements, including PF, ESI, gratuity, and regulatory filings. Liaise with statutory consultants to ensure timely compliance and audit readiness. Continuously review and refine HR policies to align with organizational growth and culture.
* Employee Experience \& HR Support: Oversee HR helpdesk operations to ensure timely resolution of employee queries, partner with business leaders to address workplace concerns and escalations, and drive consistent HR communication, announcements, and policy awareness across offices.
* Payroll Coordination: Support payroll processing by managing inputs such as new hires, exits, compensation changes, attendance data, allowances, and deductions, while collaborating closely with Finance and external payroll partners to ensure accuracy and compliance.
* HR Projects \& Transformation Initiatives: Lead HR transformation initiatives aligned with organizational priorities, including digitization journeys, experience center operations, and campus integration programs, while implementing best practices from consulting and technology industries to enhance HR operational effectiveness.


**Required Skills And Qualifications**
* MBA/PGDM in Human Resources or related field.
* Strong expertise in HR operations, statutory compliance, and HRIS systems (preferably SuccessFactors).
* Proven ability to manage complex HR workflows and multi\-location operations.
* Strong analytical mindset with experience in HR metrics and reporting.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.

title: UX/UI Design Intern
description:
UI/UX Design Intern

**Location:** Jaipur

**Company:** Exackt Techfleeters (OPC) Pvt Ltd

About Us

Exackt Techfleeters (OPC) Pvt Ltd is a dynamic and innovative tech firm dedicated to delivering high\-quality digital products. We pride ourselves on our architectural approach to software and our commitment to excellence. We are currently seeking a meticulous and forward\-thinking **UI/UX Design Intern** to join our product team and help build the visual foundation of our applications.

Job Description

We are looking for a UI/UX Intern who doesn't just "make things look pretty" but understands the mechanics of a scalable design system. You will be deeply involved in crafting high\-fidelity interfaces, building reusable components, and mapping out complex user flows. This is an ideal role for someone who is obsessed with **Figma**, loves organized layers, and wants to see their prototypes turn into real\-world products.

Responsibilities

* **Scalable UI Design:** Design modern, clean, and responsive interfaces for web and mobile applications using Figma.
* **Design Systems:** Assist in building and maintaining a robust design library, including the use of **Figma Variables** (colors, spacing, modes) and **Auto Layout** for scalable growth.
* **Prototyping:** Create interactive, high\-fidelity prototypes to demonstrate user journeys and micro\-interactions.
* **Wireframing:** Translate complex project requirements into functional wireframes and low\-fidelity blueprints.
* **User Research:** Collaborate with our Business Analysts to understand user personas and iterate designs based on feedback and data.
* **Handoff:** Prepare design files for the development team, ensuring all assets and specifications are clear and implementable.
* **Consistency:** Ensure all screens align with brand guidelines and maintain a high level of visual and functional polish.

Requirements

* Currently pursuing or recently graduated with a degree in Interaction Design, HCI, Graphic Design, or a related field.
* **Figma Power User:** Advanced knowledge of Figma is a must (Components, Variants, Auto Layout, and Prototyping).
* Strong understanding of **UX principles**, typography, color theory, and grid systems.
* A portfolio that showcases your process—from initial wireframes to polished, scalable UI screens.
* Excellent attention to detail (you're the type who notices a 1px misalignment).
* Ability to take constructive feedback and iterate quickly in a fast\-paced environment.

Preferred Qualifications

* Familiarity with **Figma Variables** and advanced prototyping features.
* Basic understanding of how designs translate to code (HTML/CSS/React logic).
* Experience with Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop/Illustrator) for asset creation.
* Interest in specialized industries like e\-commerce or inventory management systems.

What We Offer

* **Technical Growth:** Deep dive into advanced UI/UX workflows and design system architecture.
* **Mentorship:** Work directly with our product team to learn how design impacts business logic.
* **Real Impact:** Your designs won't just sit in a folder; they will be the blueprint for our live applications.
* **Culture:** A supportive, tech\-driven environment in Jaipur where innovation is encouraged.

Pay: ₹5,000\.00 \- ₹10,000\.00 per month

* Flexible schedule
* Paid time off

Education:

* Bachelor's (Preferred)

Experience:

* Design: 1 year (Required)

title: UI/UX Design Intern
description:
**About Us**

At **V7 AI Solutions LLP**, we are passionate about building AI that understands, learns, and acts on real\-world problems responsibly. Our mission is to unlock the full potential of artificial intelligence—intelligent, adaptive, autonomous, and ethical—while creating solutions that transform industries, empower organisations, and improve human lives.

At V7 AI, you will be part of a **dynamic, fast\-growing environment** where curiosity, creativity, and collaboration are highly valued. Working five days a week from our Bengaluru office (9:30 AM – 7:00 PM) allows our team to learn from each other, brainstorm ideas in real time, and build products faster and smarter.

**About the Role**

As a UI/UX Design Intern at V7 AI Solutions, you will work closely with designers, product managers, business analysts, and developers to create intuitive, user\-centric digital experiences for web and mobile applications.

You will contribute to real\-world projects — designing wireframes, user flows, prototypes, and interaction flows — while collaborating with cross\-functional teams to translate requirements into thoughtful design solutions.

This internship is designed for individuals who want hands\-on exposure to end\-to\-end product design, design systems, UX research, and AI\-assisted design workflows. You will contribute to real design cycles while learning how fast\-growing product teams build scalable, structured design processes.

This role is highly execution\-oriented and requires strong visual thinking, attention to detail, and a genuine eagerness to learn.

**Qualifications**

* Basic understanding of UI/UX principles, design thinking, and user\-centred design.
* Familiarity with Figma — components, auto layout, variants, and prototyping.
* Knowledge of user flows, wireframing, information architecture, and responsive design.
* Basic familiarity with FigJam, AI\-powered design tools, and accessibility best practices.
* Strong problem\-solving, attention to detail, and willingness to learn.
* Good communication and collaboration skills.
* Freshers and students are welcome. Academic projects, personal UI/UX work, or a portfolio are a strong plus.
* Interest in SaaS, AI, Healthcare, or startup products is an advantage.

**Responsibilities**

UX Design \& Wireframing

* Assist in creating wireframes, user flows, and prototypes for web and mobile applications.
* Develop and document user flows, web flows, and interaction flows.
* Create user\-centric designs that focus on usability, accessibility, and intuitive experiences.
* Contribute to solving user and business problems through thoughtful design solutions.

UI Design \& Design Systems

* Support UI design activities across web and mobile platforms.
* Assist in developing and maintaining design systems and reusable components.
* Create and maintain design documentation using Figma and FigJam.

Research \& Collaboration

* Participate in user research, competitor analysis, and design discussions.
* Work with product and development teams to understand requirements and translate them into design solutions.
* Participate in design reviews and improve designs based on structured feedback.

AI\-Assisted Design

* Use AI tools to support research, ideation, content generation, and wireframing.
* Explore opportunities to integrate AI\-powered design tools into existing workflows.

**Work Style Expectations**

* Takes ownership from wireframe to final handoff — no step\-by\-step hand\-holding needed.
* Thinks in systems, not just screens; cares about design rationale, not just aesthetics.
* Communicates design decisions clearly with developers, product managers, and founders.
* Proactively identifies gaps, asks clarifying questions, and improves workflows without waiting for instructions.
* Handles multiple tasks in parallel with consistent attention to detail and visual quality.
* Disciplined with documentation, component libraries, and version control.
* Comfortable with fast feedback cycles, tight timelines, and shifting priorities.
* Curious about AI tools, automation, and making design workflows more efficient.
* We value design quality, ownership, and structured thinking — more than credentials alone.
* Candidates who copy templates without understanding context may struggle in this role.

**This Role May Not Be a Good Fit If**

* You prefer repetitive production work with fixed instructions for every design task.
* You struggle with iteration, design feedback, or maintaining visual and interaction consistency.
* You are uncomfortable with fast\-paced startup environments where product requirements can evolve quickly.
* You dislike structured design documentation, component systems, or process\-oriented design work.
* You prefer low\-ownership environments with limited accountability over design outcomes.

**Internship Structure**

* **The duration of the internship is 3 months.**
* Interns who demonstrate strong performance, design ownership, learning ability, and meaningful contribution may be considered for internship extension

**Who You Will Work With**

You will work closely with the Design, Product, and Engineering teams at V7 AI Solutions. You will gain hands\-on exposure to cross\-functional collaboration, real product cycles, and the end\-to\-end workflow of building digital products in a fast\-moving startup environment.

**What You Will Learn**

During this internship, you will gain practical exposure to:

* End\-to\-end product design workflow
* UX research and requirement analysis
* User flow and web flow creation
* Design systems and component\-based design
* Real\-world collaboration with product and engineering teams
* AI\-assisted design processes
* Product thinking and problem\-solving approaches

**What Success Looks Like**

* Design deliverables are completed on time, with high quality and clear rationale.
* Product and engineering teams receive reliable, well\-documented design assets.
* User flows, prototypes, and design systems are accurate, organised, and reusable.
* Designs consistently reflect user needs, business goals, and usability principles.
* Design workflows become more structured, scalable, and efficient over time.

**Why Join Us**

At V7 AI Solutions, you will work in a fast\-moving environment where your design contribution directly impacts product quality and user experience.

This internship is ideal for individuals who enjoy solving design problems, thinking about users, building scalable systems, and contributing meaningfully in a high\-ownership startup environment.

**Job Summary**
 We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Performance Test Engineer with 3\-10 years of experience in performance engineering, load testing, and application performance monitoring.

* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.


**Roles And Responsibilities**
* Design, develop, and execute performance test scripts using LoadRunner and JMeter.
* Create realistic workload models and test scenarios based on business requirements.
* Perform load, stress, spike, endurance, volume, and scalability testing.
* Develop and execute API performance tests using Postman and other testing tools.
* Monitor application and infrastructure performance using New Relic and other monitoring solutions.
* Analyze test results and identify application, database, network, and infrastructure bottlenecks.
* Collaborate with developers, architects, DevOps, and infrastructure teams to resolve performance issues.
* Prepare detailed performance test reports, dashboards, and recommendations for stakeholders.

* Support performance testing activities across multiple environments, including QA, staging, and production.
* Participate in performance tuning initiatives and capacity planning exercises.
* Automate performance testing processes and integrate tests into CI/CD pipelines.
* Ensure adherence to performance engineering standards, processes, and best practices.
* Conduct root cause analysis for production performance issues and provide remediation recommendations.


**Preferred Skills (Good To Have)**
* Programming knowledge in Python, Java, C, VB Script, Shell Scripting, and Node.js.
* Experience in test automation and framework development.
* Knowledge of CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or GitLab CI.
* Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
* Understanding of containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
* Knowledge of databases such as Oracle, SQL Server, MySQL, PostgreSQL, or MongoDB.
* Experience with log monitoring and observability tools.
* Familiarity with Agile, Scrum, and DevOps methodologies.
* Knowledge of API testing tools and service virtualization.
* Experience working in enterprise\-scale distributed environments.

* Plan and conduct periodic idea campaigns to generate new solutions to the problems/ define better ways of working

* Demand forecasting in line with business requirements
* Anticipate attrition and ensure right talent supply chain to deliver the project
* Spearhead quarterly demand forecasting and resource planning aligned to project requirements

* Anticipate new skills/ upcoming technologies required to deliver the project and ensure the team is trained or right talent is inducted into the project as per the skill requirements
* Drive 100% compliance on trainings and upskilling requirements
* Prioritize and identify essential and upcoming technical skills required across programs/ projects to facilitate and drive right supply chain
* Drive towards 100% mandatory training compliance for the target population within an account
* Plan and drive rotations for seed positions and ensure replacement plan to be arrived ahead of rotations
* Quarterly connect with critical talent to understand their career aspirations and create their learning maps along with project managers and HRBP

* Ensure a stable arrangement and assimilation of rookie within accounts in coordination with competency group team (classroom trainings/ e\-learning, certifications, on the job training etc)

* Track team satisfaction scores and identify initiatives to build engagement within the team
* Facilitate rewards and recognition to acknowledge the high performers in the team

title: Customer Support Engineer
description:
**Customer Support Engineer**

\[Chennai / Hyderabad]

**Navidiz Software Solutions, Chennai** is the Indian Partner of **Novade Solutions, Singapore** (www.novade.net), a fast\-growing software startup developing cloud and mobile applications for the Building and Construction Industry. Our mission at Navidiz, is to help customers improve Productivity, Quality and Safety in construction projects. Our solutions are used daily by thousands of professionals from iconic organizations.

We are expanding our product portfolio, as well as our presence across Asia and Europe.

We are looking to hire a smart, self\-driven and curious individual who would like to be part of our growth story. The selected candidate will be hired by Navidiz Software Solutions to exclusively work for Novade product line in India and abroad (as necessary).

***Position Summary:*** 

Exciting career opportunity that provides a Customer Support Engineer role in the Navidiz Business Consulting team in India.

The Customer Support Engineer will support construction\-industry customers across India and international markets to ensure successful onboarding, training and product adoption.

***Roles \& Responsibilities:*** 

As Customer Support Engineer, you will be responsible for and will require the following:

**What you will be doing**

· Your mission is to ensure that customers using Novade software receive prompt and efficient support

· On assigned customer projects, your role is to ensure that the right information is gathered, projects are setup, manual processes are digitalized, users are trained to use our system

· Handling customer support tickets and escalations.

· Manual Software Testing Support of our application.

· Coordinating with product, service and development teams in Novade Singapore.

· Providing product demonstrations \& training sessions and troubleshooting customer issues

**What you need to succeed in this position**

**Academics:**

· An engineering graduate (UG/PG) with specialization in Civil/EEC/EEE/CSE

· New Graduates may apply

**Job Skills:**

· Familiarity with reading building/technical drawings

· Experience in or Knowledge of software used in the construction industry is an added advantage

· Basic understanding of building and construction processes

· Ability to use technology, mobile apps and cloud services as relevant to construction

· Familiarity with construction processes such as checklist driven construction activities, inspection, snagging and handover of building projects is a plus.

· Experience in Microsoft Office suite and some knowledge of how databases work

· Minimal experience in a Customer Support role for similar software (a plus)

· Good verbal \& written communication skills in English and verbal Communication in Hindi is must. Communication in Telugu is an added advantage.

· Detail oriented, self\-driven and self\-organized (ability to work independently with minimal supervision)

· Positive work attitude

· Learning mindset

· Resident of Chennai or Hyderabad or Pune (a plus, not mandatory). Should be able to travel and/or re\-locate to Work Site Pan India as needed.

**Top reasons to work with us**

· Attractive package (Salary, Annual Performance Bonus, PF, Hospital \& Accident Insurance, Gratuity)

· Well\-funded company with solid leadership and talented, dynamic and experienced team

· Benevolent organization that cares for people, offers a fun filled work environment and invests in individual’s growth and their well being

· Growth Opportunities: successful employees in this position could expand their responsibilities into Software Testing, Sales or such other suitable roles

Looking forward to receiving your resume and going over the position with you. Please email your resume to HR, Navidiz: biz\-ops@navidiz.com. For Novade product details refer to www.novade.net

Job Types: Full\-time, Permanent, Fresher

Pay: ₹15,000\.00 \- ₹25,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Health insurance
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Application Question(s):

* Do you have knowledge in construction Industry.

Education:

* Bachelor's (Required)

Language:

* Hindi (Required)
* Telugu (Preferred)
* English (Required)

Willingness to travel:

* 50% (Required)

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Hyderabad, Telangana

title: Network Support Engineer
description:
Job description:

We are hiring for the Network Engineer position in Vadodara and are currently giving preference to local Vadodara\-based candidates.

Experience: Fresher to 1 Year

Rotation Shifts (5 Days Working)

* 8:00 AM to 4 PM
* 4:00 PM to 12:00 AM
* 12:00 AM to 8:00 AM

Job Description

* Excellent English communication skills (Written and verbal)
* In depth understanding of TCP/IP LAN/WAN networking technologies and troubleshooting techniques.
* Experience with configuring business\-class firewalls and VPNs
* In depth understanding of wireless technologies.

Requirements

* Candidate should know about Remote Desktop / virtualization technology.
* Candidate should know about Networking Topologies
* Understanding of network protocols like HTTP, HTTPS, SNMP, DNS, DHCP, VLAN and VPN.
* In depth knowledge of following concepts: Load balancing, failover, Cloud Computing, Network Security
* Ability to solve desktop/Laptop related issues independently.
* Must have hands on experience with Network equipments i.e router, switches, modem, access point, bridge, firewall.
* Monitoring skill to check the network performance and troubleshoot problem.

**Company Overview:** FoodChain ID is a global leader in food safety, regulatory compliance, and sustainability solutions. We support organizations across the food and agriculture value chain with certification, advisory, and data\-driven services that help bring safe, compliant, and sustainable products to market. With teams across the globe, we combine deep technical expertise with practical, market\-focused solutions to help customers navigate complex regulatory and certification landscapes  

  

**Role Overview:** We are seeking a dedicated Assistant Scheme Administrator to support our certification team in maintaining the highest standards of audit review and compliance. The role focuses on audit document review, scheme compliance, and certification database management, making it an ideal fit for candidates with a relevant academic background and a keen eye for detail.

* Review new scheme requirements and update audit guidelines, accordingly, keeping inspectors informed of any changes.

* Handle client communications in a professional and timely manner.

* Issue Transaction Certificates and certificates under other applicable standards.

* Initiate and arrange sampling of commodities as required.
* Maintain the certification database and ensure records are accurate and current.
* Manage client communications and filing systems in a professional and timely manner.
* Carry out any other related tasks assigned by management.

  

**Why Join Us?**  

Join a globally recognized leader in food safety, certification, and sustainability, where your work directly contributes to bringing safe and compliant products to market. You will gain hands\-on exposure to diverse organic certification schemes and EU regulatory frameworks, while growing through continuous learning and training opportunities. Be part of a technically strong, values\-driven global team with competitive compensation and clear career growth prospects.

description:
**Technical Service Engineer**


**Surendranagar, Gujarat**

  

**About Us**


Del Pd Pumps \& Gears as Ingersoll Rand Inc. (NYSE:IR), has emerged as the leading \& dominant rotary positive displacement gear pump manufacturer of Indian subcontinents offering widest range of most compact, reliable, efficient \& elegant rotary gear, twin gear \& triplet win gear pump for all viscous and semi\-viscous liquid applications. Company started it’s business in year 1980 as a small proprietary venture to design, develop, manufacture \& market these pumps starting with small, low cost, general purpose gear pumps as a standard product readily available though network of dealers. The company followed brick \& mortar economy with consistence commitment to produce quality embedded product. Company also addressed the typical pumping problem peculiar while handling viscous liquid and also offered free guidance in selective, installing \& using such pumps to ensure constant growth of the company and expand into OE \& Project business.

  

**Job Summary**


The Service Engineer is responsible for installation, commissioning, maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair of centrifugal and gear pumps at customer sites. The role requires strong mechanical expertise, hands\-on field service experience, and customer interaction to ensure optimal pump performance and customer satisfaction.


**Key Responsibilities**


* Install, commission, and test **centrifugal and gear pumps** at customer locations
* Carry out **preventive, predictive, and breakdown maintenance** of pumps and pumping systems
* Diagnose and resolve issues related to flow, pressure, vibration, noise, leakage, overheating, and seal failures
* Perform **pump dismantling, inspection, reconditioning, alignment, and reassembly**
* Handle replacement and fitting of mechanical seals, bearings, shafts, impellers, gears, and couplings
* Conduct performance evaluation and basic troubleshooting of pump\-motor assemblies
* Provide on\-site technical support, operational guidance, and training to customer personnel
* Ensure adherence to safety standards and company quality procedures during service activities
* Prepare detailed **service reports, inspection reports, and job completion documents**
* Coordinate with production, quality, spares, and sales teams for technical resolution
* Support warranty claims, root cause analysis (RCA), and corrective/preventive actions
* Travel extensively to customer sites and attend emergency service calls when required

**Qualifications \& Experience**


* Diploma / BE / BTech in **Mechanical Engineering** (preferred)
* 1–5 years of experience in servicing **centrifugal and gear pumps**
* Freshers with strong fundamentals and industry exposure may also be considered

**Technical Skills**


* Strong knowledge of **centrifugal pumps, gear pumps, and pumping systems**
* Understanding of pump hydraulics, clearances, materials, and performance curves
* Familiarity with mechanical seals, gland packing, bearings, and couplings
* Ability to read **GA drawings, P\&ID diagrams, and technical manuals**
* Basic electrical knowledge of motors and starter panels (preferred)

**Soft Skills**


* Good communication and customer\-handling skills
* Strong problem\-solving and analytical abilities
* Willingness to travel and work independently at sites
* Time management and documentation discipline
* Team\-oriented and service\-focused attitude

**Working Conditions**

* May involve emergency and breakdown service support

* Design: Develop network architectures and solutions tailored to client needs.
* Implementation: Deploy network systems and components, including routers, switches, firewalls, and wireless access points.



**Configuration and Optimization:** 



* Routers: Configure and optimize routing protocols and settings.
* Switches: Set up and manage LAN switches, including VLAN configuration.
* Firewalls: Implement and configure firewalls to secure network perimeters.
* Wireless Access Points: Install and configure to provide secure Wi\-Fi connectivity.
* Load Balancers: Deploy and manage load balancing solutions for optimal traffic distribution.



  





**Testing and Validation:** 
 Conduct rigorous testing and validation of network setups to confirm functionality, performance, and alignment with client requirements.
 



**Troubleshooting and Support:** 
 Diagnose and resolve network issues encountered during and after implementation. Provide ongoing support to maintain system stability and client satisfaction.
 



**Documentation:** 
 Develop and maintain detailed documentation of network configurations, installation processes, and client\-specific instructions. Ensure all changes and updates are accurately recorded.
 



**Compliance and Standards:** 
 Ensure all network implementations adhere to industry standards, best practices, and regulatory requirements.
 



**Project Coordination:** 
 Collaborate with project managers and other stakeholders to ensure timely delivery of network solutions, within budget, and according to project specifications.
 



  





  





 Requirements
 


* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Network Engineering,or a related field.
* CCNA (Cisco Certified Network Associate) certification is required; additional certifications (e.g., CCNP, CCIE) are preferred.
* Minimum of 5\+ years of experience in network engineering, with at least 3 years focusing on network implementation and client\-facing roles.
* Extensive experience in configuring and managing various network components and technologies.
* Proficiency in network protocols, routing, switching, and security practices.
* Familiarity with network management and monitoring tools.
* Willingness to travel to client sites as necessary.
* Proven ability to manage projects, adhere to deadlines, and work collaboratively with various teams and stakeholders.

description:

 We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model.
   

  

 Why MongoDB is a fantastic place to work and build your career
   

  

* Be a part of the company that’s reinventing the database, focused on innovation and speed
* Enjoy a fun, inspiring culture that is engineering focused
* Work with talented people around the globe
